newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Quaker Oats cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Quaker Oats cut to hold.

text.p: -- CS First Boston analyst Michael Mauboussin confirmed he downgraded Quaker Oats Co to hold from buy.
-- Mouboussin said his earlier buy rating had been based on the belief the company would lay out a restructuring plan, but Quaker did not do so on Thursday when it reported fourth quarter results.

-- "We had a thesis predicated on a restructuring and we were looking for evidence that restructuring was coming sooner rather than later," Mauboussin said. He said he no longer expected such a plan would come soon.
